predictions.reasoning: A shift in the implied probability of Gavin Newsom winning the 2028 Democratic nomination — an event more than two years away — carries essentially no information for near-term asset prices. Even a sharp move in this market reflects intra-Democratic-primary positioning, not policy that will be enacted, general-election odds, or any macro catalyst that would move equities within a 12-hour window. There is no clean transmission channel to any liquid instrument at this horizon.

evidence_used: Market concerns the 2028 Democratic nomination, resolving years in the future
No near-term policy or macro catalyst tied to the question
uncertainty_notes: A very sharp move could accompany a real-time political shock, but that shock (not the market) would be the true driver
Any equity read-through would be sector-specific and highly speculative, not index-level
2028 primary odds have negligible bearing on present-day cash flows or rates

llm_justification.summary: This market maps a distant (2028) intra-party nomination question to public assets. There is no credible transmission channel from Newsom's nomination odds to any liquid instrument within a 12-hour window. Even a large probability swing reflects political positioning years ahead of any enactable policy or general-election outcome. The honest mapping is 'unclear' with very low confidence and no tradable move — the market is noise for asset-pricing purposes at this horizon.
key_assumptions: The 2028 nomination remains too distant to affect near-term discount rates or earnings expectations
No simultaneous macro or breaking-news catalyst is conflated with the political market move
Broad, liquid proxies show no meaningful sensitivity to primary-field repricing
failure_modes: The market move could coincide with genuine breaking political news that itself moves risk sentiment, making the correlation look causal
A weak-proxy problem: even if some sector (California utilities, healthcare) is loosely exposed to Newsom policy, the 12-hour link is negligible
The move may be already public/anticipated, offering no leaked information
Thin, low-liquidity prediction market prone to random swings unrelated to any real information
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
